subject: Ownership handoff matrix and sensitive transition plan
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy PeopleOps <amy@peopleops.consulting>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ownership handoff matrix and sensitive transition plan

Team —

As discussed in last week's leadership sync, we need to produce a concrete ownership handoff matrix for the infra/runtime teams that minimizes customer impact and protects sensitive performance review windows. This will be shared with People Ops and Legal next week.

Goals for this thread:
- Agree on clear owner for each scope (model serving, KV cache, batching, runtime infra).
- Identify roles with sensitive one-on-one coordination (people mid-review cycle).
- Propose a manager comm cadence and a timeline for staggered handoffs.

I started a draft matrix and attached a first pass (ownership_handoff_matrix_v1.xlsx). Please review the draft and annotate in the sheet where you see risk or conflicts. Specific asks: 
- Marcus: map current IC owners to proposed owners and call out any single points of failure.
- Soojin: flag any team members currently in active performance review windows — we need mitigation suggestions.
- Aditya & Lauren: comment on comm plan and legal escalation points.

We need a version to share with People Ops by Monday EOD (11/08).

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Director, Infrastructure Productivity
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ownership_handoff_matrix_v1.xlsx]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy PeopleOps <amy@peopleops.consulting>, J. Kim <j.kim@thirdparty-legal.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ownership handoff matrix and sensitive transition plan

Thanks Chloe — I pulled the sheet and added a second tab called "sensitive_windows" with four names who are mid-cycle (performance calibration in Dec). I marked recommended mitigations inline:

- Staggered shadowing for 2 weeks before any role change.
- No comp-related conversations during the 30 days around the review finalize window.
- For high-visibility roles, escalate changes to People Ops with 1:1 transition plans.

I also added commentary in the matrix where ownership is currently split across two people — those need clear single owners or explicit co-owner expectations.

Notes attached: sensitive_transition_notes.docx

Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sensitive_transition_notes.docx]

Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ownership handoff matrix and sensitive transition plan

Chloe / team —

Thanks for kicking this off. I updated the primary-owner column in the workbook so each capability has a single accountable person and a secondary contact for coverage. High-level comments:

- Runtime infra (serving runtime): recommend Marcus Lin (primary), backup: Mina Haddad — current ramp for Mina is +2 weeks.
- KV cache ownership should remain with the model-serving pod until 1/15 to allow cache invalidation tests; I added that guardrail in the timeline column.
- Batching config and autoscaler policy: move to a shared "Cost & Latency" owner (I put Lauren as primary) for consistent cross-model policies.

Risk flags:
1) Two ICs flagged in the sensitive tab are on performance plans in December — Soojin's mitigation is necessary.
2) Several handoffs require updated runbooks and a short rehearsal window; recommend scheduling rehearsals the week before handoffs.

I attached a short manager comm doc (manager_comm_cadence.pdf) with suggested talking points for all managers.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: manager_comm_cadence.pdf]

Subject: Re: Ownership handoff matrix and sensitive transition plan

All —

Reviewed the matrix and the attachments. From a leadership/comms standpoint I have two asks before we push to People Ops:

1) Add a short decision log column (why we changed the owner) so People Ops can see the rationale during audits.
2) For the people flagged in sensitive_windows, include a proposed 1:1 transition script that managers can use. We should avoid surprises in private conversations.

If those are in, approve to share with People Ops. We should also set a 30-minute sync with Amy on Tuesday (11/09) to walk the plan.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I incorporated Marcus' primary-owner edits and Aditya's request for a decision log column. I also drafted short manager 1:1 scripts for the three sensitive people and copied them into the sensitive tab.

Next steps: 
- I will share v2 with People Ops and Legal after the 11/09 sync with Amy.
- Managers will run a 1:1 using the provided script inside the next two weeks (no comp conversations until Jan 5).
- Schedule rehearsals for technical handoffs the week before each transfer; Marcus to own scheduling.

If there are no objections by EOD Tuesday (11/09), I will mark this "ready for People Ops" and book the walk-through.

-Chloe
